dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Kokomi appears to have fallen asleep. Piles of documents line the table. Going through them must have expended a great deal of her energy.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (This is a rare moment off for her. Best not to wake her up.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #(You wait for a while more. You unconsciously glance at the notebook that has fallen open on the table. Elegant writing catches your eye — "{NICKNAME} hasn't visited Watatsumi Island in a while. Energy -3")

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (...Perhaps we should find a moment when she's free to swing by and have a chat.)
